title: Polynomial-time computability of four transformations
statement: Let $C_w,c\in\mathbb{N}$. For every choice among four transformations of bit strings, the resulting function is polynomial-time computable: return the second component of the twice nested pair parsing; return its fixed-width binary successor, or the empty word if that increment overflows or the parsing fails; or return a word of $C_w(|x|+1)^c$ zeros or ones, where $x$ is obtained by applying the total first projection twice (with failed parses yielding the empty word).
hypotheses_covered: the transformation is any one of the four constructors: copy, increment, zero word, or one word
